answer: To resist sybils each agent locks a 400-POA bond for 36 hours. Every epoch it must generate a non-parallelizable sequential hash chain from a private plume seed taking 12 single-core minutes to reach the nadir checkpoint. A farm of N identities freezes N*400 POA and burns N*12 minutes of exclusive CPU; honest agents recover bonds after clean delta periods. Duplicate sequential outputs in the same window slash the bond.
